allow_large: Owner allowed it: the interfaces glob **/routes/** matches the web app's screen folder apps/web/src/routes/profile, but this fix only adds two navigation links and tests, with no API change
done_when: the signed-in home screen has a 'Your profile' link that opens the profile in one tap, the profile has a way back to home, and a phone-width browser test starts on the home screen and taps through to the profile and to sign-out instead of typing the address

findings.body: This test builds a mock router and API response to check that the link has `/profile` as its href. The new Playwright test already starts on the signed-in home screen and taps that link through to the profile, so the mocked component test adds setup without proving another requested behavior.
findings.title: Simpler: remove the mocked home-link test → keep the browser navigation test

why: Signed-in members cannot reach their profile or sign out: no screen links to the profile, and the installed app has no address bar
